blocks.text: The Whole Universe Comes from One Seed, and You Keep Getting Distracted.
blocks.directed: The Whole Universe Comes from One Seed, and You Keep Getting Distracted.

blocks.text: The dissolution of the universe through contemplation.
blocks.directed: The dissolution of the universe through contemplation.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta brings us back to something exceptionally direct.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta brings us back to something exceptionally direct.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja gives us a beautifully precise interpretation.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja gives us a beautifully precise interpretation.

blocks.text: The source of the entire manifested universe.
blocks.directed: The source of the entire manifested universe.

blocks.text: And its nature is sphurattā — the luminous, vibrant manifestation of self-aware consciousness.
blocks.directed: And its nature is sphurattā — the luminous, vibrant manifestation of self-aware consciousness.

blocks.text: Ordinarily a seed is something small.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily a seed is something small.

blocks.text: And eventually an entire tree emerges.
blocks.directed: And eventually an entire tree emerges.

blocks.text: And within those fruits, further seeds.
blocks.directed: And within those fruits, further seeds.

blocks.text: The seed appears almost insignificant compared with the vast complexity that unfolds from it.
blocks.directed: The seed appears almost insignificant compared with the vast complexity that unfolds from it.

blocks.text: But it contains, in a particular causal sense, the potential for the subsequent development.
blocks.directed: But it contains, in a particular causal sense, the potential for the subsequent development.

blocks.text: Now, Kṣemarāja is using the seed as a metaphysical principle.
blocks.directed: Now, Kṣemarāja is using the seed as a metaphysical principle.

blocks.text: Not suggesting that there is a tiny physical object somewhere inside your skull containing miniature galaxies.
blocks.directed: Not suggesting that there is a tiny physical object somewhere inside your skull containing miniature galaxies.

blocks.text: The seed is the divine power from which manifestation proceeds.
blocks.directed: The seed is the divine power from which manifestation proceeds.

blocks.text: And that power is not independent of consciousness.
blocks.directed: And that power is not independent of consciousness.

blocks.text: The supreme creative power of Śiva.
blocks.directed: The supreme creative power of Śiva.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explains that even after the attainment of freedom, the yogi should not become udāsīna — indifferent or inattentive.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explains that even after the attainment of freedom, the yogi should not become udāsīna — indifferent or inattentive.

blocks.text: Instead, they must repeatedly direct the mind towards the seed.
blocks.directed: Instead, they must repeatedly direct the mind towards the seed.
[short pause] The commentary uses the expression:

blocks.text: Repeatedly placing or establishing the mind.
blocks.directed: Repeatedly placing or establishing the mind.

blocks.text: Because it explains why the text doesn’t simply end after announcing the attainment of freedom.
blocks.directed: Because it explains why the text doesn’t simply end after announcing the attainment of freedom.

blocks.text: You might imagine that once the yogi has recognised divine consciousness, there’s nothing left to discuss.
blocks.directed: You might imagine that once the yogi has recognised divine consciousness, there’s nothing left to discuss.

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja insists upon continuing attention to the supreme source.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja insists upon continuing attention to the supreme source.

blocks.text: Because the teaching concerns the stable establishment of recognition, not merely a passing experience.
blocks.directed: Because the teaching concerns the stable establishment of recognition, not merely a passing experience.

blocks.text: Remember the end of Book II?
blocks.directed: Remember the end of Book II?

blocks.text: When pure knowledge subsides, dreamlike differentiation reappears.
blocks.directed: When pure knowledge subsides, dreamlike differentiation reappears.

blocks.text: You can recognise the truth and then become absorbed once again in limited cognition.
blocks.directed: You can recognise the truth and then become absorbed once again in limited cognition.

blocks.text: And now, in Book III, we find the corresponding instruction.
blocks.directed: And now, in Book III, we find the corresponding instruction.

blocks.text: Return your attention to the seed.
blocks.directed: Return your attention to the seed.

blocks.text: Not necessarily by repeating a particular verbal formula endlessly.
blocks.directed: Not necessarily by repeating a particular verbal formula endlessly.

blocks.text: But by sustaining contemplative attention towards the fundamental power of consciousness.
blocks.directed: But by sustaining contemplative attention towards the fundamental power of consciousness.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja identifies the seed as the cause of the universe and cites the Netratantra on the supreme Goddess as the source of the gods and divine powers, characterised symbolically through fire and moon. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja identifies the seed as the cause of the universe and cites the Netratantra on the supreme Goddess as the source of the gods and divine powers, characterised symbolically through fire and moon. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: Now this is where the symbolism becomes magnificent.
blocks.directed: Now this is where the symbolism becomes magnificent.

blocks.text: The varied differentiations through which divine manifestation is described.
blocks.directed: The varied differentiations through which divine manifestation is described.

blocks.text: The supreme Śakti is the source from which the innumerable powers proceed.
blocks.directed: The supreme Śakti is the source from which the innumerable powers proceed.

blocks.text: But the practitioner is instructed to attend not merely to their countless differentiated expressions.
blocks.directed: But the practitioner is instructed to attend not merely to their countless differentiated expressions.

blocks.text: And notice how this relates to everything we’ve studied.
blocks.directed: And notice how this relates to everything we’ve studied.

blocks.text: At 3.1, the Self in its contracted condition was identified with mind.
blocks.directed: At 3.1, the Self in its contracted condition was identified with mind.

blocks.text: At 3.3, Māyā was associated with the failure to discern the principles of manifestation.
blocks.directed: At 3.3, Māyā was associated with the failure to discern the principles of manifestation.

blocks.text: Then the practitioner began the work of contemplation.
blocks.directed: Then the practitioner began the work of contemplation.

blocks.text: The body was dissolved into its causal principles.
blocks.directed: The body was dissolved into its causal principles.

blocks.text: The senses and subtle faculties became instruments of practice.
blocks.directed: The senses and subtle faculties became instruments of practice.

blocks.text: The whole universe was recognised as the manifestation of consciousness.
blocks.directed: The whole universe was recognised as the manifestation of consciousness.

blocks.text: The yogi attained the understanding of divine freedom.
blocks.directed: The yogi attained the understanding of divine freedom.

blocks.text: And now the mind, which was initially bound by its own limited operation, becomes directed towards the very source of manifestation.
blocks.directed: And now the mind, which was initially bound by its own limited operation, becomes directed towards the very source of manifestation.

blocks.text: The mind that was absorbed in the branches turns towards the seed.
blocks.directed: The mind that was absorbed in the branches turns towards the seed.

blocks.text: And here there’s a wonderful relationship with Śāktopāya.
blocks.directed: And here there’s a wonderful relationship with Śāktopāya.

blocks.text: Not every wandering thought automatically functioning as a liberating formula, but mental activity transformed through contemplation of the supreme reality.
blocks.directed: Not every wandering thought automatically functioning as a liberating formula, but mental activity transformed through contemplation of the supreme reality.

blocks.text: The mind becomes directed towards Parā Śakti.
blocks.directed: The mind becomes directed towards Parā Śakti.

blocks.text: The source of the entire universe.
blocks.directed: The source of the entire universe.

blocks.text: The power through which manifestation arises.
blocks.directed: The power through which manifestation arises.

blocks.text: The consciousness in which the entire process appears.
blocks.directed: The consciousness in which the entire process appears.

blocks.text: Now, consider an ordinary practical analogy.
blocks.directed: Now, consider an ordinary practical analogy.

blocks.text: You recognise the presence of awareness.
blocks.directed: You recognise the presence of awareness.

blocks.text: You begin solving a problem that doesn’t currently exist.
blocks.directed: You begin solving a problem that doesn’t currently exist.

blocks.text: And approximately twenty minutes later, you’re mentally having an argument with a man you haven’t seen since secondary school.
blocks.directed: And approximately twenty minutes later, you’re mentally having an argument with a man you haven’t seen since secondary school.

blocks.text: You’ve travelled through an entire personal universe without leaving your cushion.
blocks.directed: You’ve travelled through an entire personal universe without leaving your cushion.
[short pause] But now the instruction is:

blocks.text: Not by violently suppressing every mental event.
blocks.directed: Not by violently suppressing every mental event.

blocks.text: Not by trying to construct an artificial blankness.
blocks.directed: Not by trying to construct an artificial blankness.

blocks.text: But by directing attention towards the conscious reality through which all those events become manifest.
blocks.directed: But by directing attention towards the conscious reality through which all those events become manifest.

blocks.text: The point is not that each return creates consciousness.
blocks.directed: The point is not that each return creates consciousness.

blocks.text: Consciousness was never absent in the first place.
blocks.directed: Consciousness was never absent in the first place.

blocks.text: And the stabilisation of that recognition.
blocks.directed: And the stabilisation of that recognition.

blocks.text: This is where Trika becomes extremely practical.
blocks.directed: This is where Trika becomes extremely practical.

blocks.text: But the fundamental orientation is beautifully simple.
blocks.directed: But the fundamental orientation is beautifully simple.

blocks.text: The entire manifestation arises through Śakti.
blocks.directed: The entire manifestation arises through Śakti.

blocks.text: And the practitioner turns towards its source.
blocks.directed: And the practitioner turns towards its source.

blocks.text: But as the conscious power fundamental to their own existence.
blocks.directed: But as the conscious power fundamental to their own existence.

blocks.text: And now the cosmic theatre becomes almost unbearably beautiful.
blocks.directed: And now the cosmic theatre becomes almost unbearably beautiful.

blocks.text: The stage is the inner being.
blocks.directed: The stage is the inner being.

blocks.text: The drama is the manifestation of the universe.
blocks.directed: The drama is the manifestation of the universe.

blocks.text: And the seed is the supreme power through which the entire production becomes possible.
blocks.directed: And the seed is the supreme power through which the entire production becomes possible.

blocks.text: The actor has been performing for so long that he’s become absorbed in the role.
blocks.directed: The actor has been performing for so long that he’s become absorbed in the role.

blocks.text: He fights with the other characters.
blocks.directed: He fights with the other characters.

blocks.text: He becomes terrified that the performance might end.
blocks.directed: He becomes terrified that the performance might end.

blocks.text: He recognises the divine power through which the whole performance appears.
blocks.directed: He recognises the divine power through which the whole performance appears.

blocks.text: But the fundamental misunderstanding is beginning to dissolve.
blocks.directed: But the fundamental misunderstanding is beginning to dissolve.

blocks.text: The performance no longer conceals its source.
blocks.directed: The performance no longer conceals its source.

blocks.text: What a way to finish this first stretch of Āṇavopāya.
blocks.directed: What a way to finish this first stretch of Āṇavopāya.

blocks.text:
The Great Reveal — What Did Vasugupta Actually Just Do?
Fifteen sūtras.
blocks.directed:
The Great Reveal — What Did Vasugupta Actually Just Do?
Fifteen sūtras.

blocks.text: And the progression is astonishingly coherent.
blocks.directed: And the progression is astonishingly coherent.

blocks.text: The apparently limited individual identifies with the mental apparatus.
blocks.directed: The apparently limited individual identifies with the mental apparatus.

blocks.text: Knowledge reinforces the distinction between subject and object.
blocks.directed: Knowledge reinforces the distinction between subject and object.

blocks.text: Māyā sustains the misrecognition of the principles of manifestation.
blocks.directed: Māyā sustains the misrecognition of the principles of manifestation.

blocks.text: And the individual remains entangled in conditioned existence.
blocks.directed: And the individual remains entangled in conditioned existence.

blocks.text: The manifested principles are contemplated in their withdrawal towards their source.
blocks.directed: The manifested principles are contemplated in their withdrawal towards their source.

blocks.text: The body becomes a field of practice.
blocks.directed: The body becomes a field of practice.

blocks.text: The subtle faculties and vital powers become instruments of concentration.
blocks.directed: The subtle faculties and vital powers become instruments of concentration.

blocks.text: And the yogi begins moving beyond the ordinary identification with differentiated manifestation.
blocks.directed: And the yogi begins moving beyond the ordinary identification with differentiated manifestation.

blocks.text: Extraordinary powers can remain within delusion.
blocks.directed: Extraordinary powers can remain within delusion.

blocks.text: The practitioner must not mistake unusual experiences for recognition of the supreme.
blocks.directed: The practitioner must not mistake unusual experiences for recognition of the supreme.

blocks.text: The conquest of delusion culminates in the mastery of innate knowledge.
blocks.directed: The conquest of delusion culminates in the mastery of innate knowledge.

blocks.text: And now the world becomes transformed in meaning.
blocks.directed: And now the world becomes transformed in meaning.

blocks.text: It is recognised as the radiance of consciousness.
blocks.directed: It is recognised as the radiance of consciousness.

blocks.text: Then the extraordinary theatrical sequence begins.
blocks.directed: Then the extraordinary theatrical sequence begins.

blocks.text: The inner self is the stage.
blocks.directed: The inner self is the stage.

blocks.text: And refined intelligence discloses the subtle inner nature of consciousness.
blocks.directed: And refined intelligence discloses the subtle inner nature of consciousness.

blocks.text: But recognition of the supreme divine freedom of consciousness.
blocks.directed: But recognition of the supreme divine freedom of consciousness.

blocks.text: And this freedom is not restricted to a single particular locus.
blocks.directed: And this freedom is not restricted to a single particular locus.

blocks.text: But the yogi must not become inattentive.
blocks.directed: But the yogi must not become inattentive.

blocks.text: The supreme source remains the object of contemplative orientation.
blocks.directed: The supreme source remains the object of contemplative orientation.

blocks.text:
The Most Beautiful Thing About This Section
There’s something extraordinary about the structure of the three books.
blocks.directed:
The Most Beautiful Thing About This Section
There’s something extraordinary about the structure of the three books.

blocks.text: But not three ultimately separate realities.
blocks.directed: But not three ultimately separate realities.

blocks.text: From the highest standpoint, the Self is universal consciousness.
blocks.directed: From the highest standpoint, the Self is universal consciousness.

blocks.text: From the standpoint of Śakti, mental activity can become a vehicle of divine recognition.
blocks.directed: From the standpoint of Śakti, mental activity can become a vehicle of divine recognition.

blocks.text: From the standpoint of the limited individual, the Self appears contracted into identification with the mind.
blocks.directed: From the standpoint of the limited individual, the Self appears contracted into identification with the mind.

blocks.text: And the entire practice involves recognising the relationship between these conditions.
blocks.directed: And the entire practice involves recognising the relationship between these conditions.

blocks.text: The point is not to create a supreme Self somewhere beyond the individual.
blocks.directed: The point is not to create a supreme Self somewhere beyond the individual.

blocks.text: Nor is it to turn the individual ego into an infinitely powerful superhuman.
blocks.directed: Nor is it to turn the individual ego into an infinitely powerful superhuman.

blocks.text: It’s to recognise the conscious reality through which the individual, its mind, its body, and the entire universe become manifest.
blocks.directed: It’s to recognise the conscious reality through which the individual, its mind, its body, and the entire universe become manifest.

blocks.text: The limited individual is never actually outside Śiva.
blocks.directed: The limited individual is never actually outside Śiva.

blocks.text: Even the ignorance belongs to the manifestation of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Even the ignorance belongs to the manifestation of consciousness.

blocks.text: Even the effort belongs to Śakti.
blocks.directed: Even the effort belongs to Śakti.

blocks.text: Even the practices are expressions of divine power.
blocks.directed: Even the practices are expressions of divine power.

blocks.text: And even the forgetting occurs within the reality that can never be fundamentally absent.
blocks.directed: And even the forgetting occurs within the reality that can never be fundamentally absent.

blocks.text: The dancer has never ceased to be the dancer.
blocks.directed: The dancer has never ceased to be the dancer.

blocks.text: But he has become absorbed in his performance.
blocks.directed: But he has become absorbed in his performance.

blocks.text: The recognition isn’t a new actor entering the stage.
blocks.directed: The recognition isn’t a new actor entering the stage.

blocks.text: It’s the original actor recognising his own nature.
blocks.directed: It’s the original actor recognising his own nature.
